reading.body:
QTS New Albany 1 DC1 occupies a confirmed address in New Albany, Ohio, serving the Columbus metro area. The operator publishes no megawatt capacity for this campus, preventing any calculation of its rack density or accelerator hosting potential relative to other facilities.

Ohio has 76 mapped data center facilities with only 8 publishing power capacity figures totaling 60.4 MW. This campus does not rank among the eight with published capacity in the state, meaning its power footprint is either below the threshold of those eight or undisclosed.

Without published specifications, this facility cannot be assessed as a constraint on or contributor to AI scaling in Ohio or regionally. A future research session with available search budget should attempt to retrieve capacity data from QTS directly or from local permitting records.
